scams.name: Cancún Airport 'Visitax' Agent Departure-Fee & Fake-Tax Scam
scams.avoidance: Pay Visitax ONLY via visitax.gob.mx BEFORE trip (MX$ 271 per person) Save PDF confirmation to phone; show if challenged IGNORE every airport 'tax agent' approach — govt does NOT collect at airport REFUSE every WhatsApp/SMS 'Visitax unpaid' phishing US Embassy 24-hr +52 55 8526 2561 if pressured
scams.location: Cancún International Airport (CUN) Terminals 2/3/4 departure halls, 'tax agent' kiosks near immigration, boarding-gate approach, WhatsApp-based fake portals

scams.name: Cancún Airport (CUN) Arrival Taxi Mafia & 'Private Shuttle' Overcharge
scams.avoidance: Book pre-paid shuttle online (eTransfers, Canada Transfers) US$ 15–US$ 30 OR Uber in-app after luggage — CUN allows since 2024, MX$ 350–MX$ 500 OR ADO bus MX$ 150 to Hotel Zone terminal (40 min) IGNORE every 'private transfer' sign-holder inside arrivals Cancún Tourist Police: +52 998 884 9070
scams.location: Cancún International Airport (CUN) Terminals 2/3/4 arrivals halls, sign-holder zones outside customs, 'private transfer' booths, Hotel Zone & Playa del Carmen drop-offs

scams.name: Cancún Hotel Zone Timeshare 'Free Breakfast' Presentation Extortion
scams.avoidance: JUST SAY NO at welcome desk — 'free' perks aren't worth 3-5 hours If trapped, stand up and walk out at exactly 90 min; ignore closer tactics NEVER authorize any credit-card hold during a presentation Mexican 5-business-day cooling-off period legally guaranteed File PROFECO complaint at profeco.gob.mx within 5 days if you signed
scams.location: Hotel Zone resorts (Iberostar, Palace Resorts, Grand Fiesta Americana), lobby 'welcome desk' kiosks, beach-bar resort outreach, pre-booked 'excursion' offers

scams.name: Cancún ATM DCC Scam & Hotel USD-to-Pesos Exchange Padding
scams.avoidance: Bank-branch ATMs only (HSBC, Banamex, Santander) during business hours ALWAYS select 'NO' / 'Continue in MX$' for DCC prompt Set MX$ 3,000 daily limit + transaction alerts Exchange small USD at downtown casa de cambio; hotel rate is 10%+ padded Prefer tap-to-pay credit card — 1–2% better than ATM rate
scams.location: Hotel Zone freestanding ATMs, hotel-lobby ATM booths, OXXO/Cardtronics ATMs, resort 'front desk' USD-to-pesos exchange, cruise-pier ATMs

scams.name: Cancún Corrupt Police Bribe Shakedown in Hotel Zone & Downtown
scams.avoidance: Ask for BADGE with name + officer number; write down immediately Say 'quiero hablar con el consulado' + '911 por favor' NEVER surrender passport — show laminated photocopy NEVER pay cash on spot — insist on written fine at delegación US Embassy +52 55 8526 2561; Cancún Consulate +52 998 883 0272
scams.location: Hotel Zone Boulevard Kukulcán, Downtown Cancún Mercado 28 area, Parque Las Palapas at night, Hotel Zone Zone 10 nightlife strip, rental-car checkpoints

scams.name: Cancún Hotel Zone Tourist-Menu Restaurant Bill-Padding & Surcharge Fraud
scams.avoidance: Eat in Downtown Cancún (not Hotel Zone) — 1/3 price at Av. Yaxchilán Ask for 'menú local' or 'menú en español' in Hotel Zone Seafood: agree weight + price/kg IN WRITING before cooking Inspect bill line-by-line; refuse 12–15% card surcharges Reputable: Benazuza, Navios, El Fish Fritanga, Taquería Coapa
scams.location: Hotel Zone Boulevard Kukulcán restaurants, La Isla Shopping Village dining, Plaza Forum mall restaurants, Downtown Mercado 28 tourist-zone eateries
